prompt:
透明背景。Create ONE complete full-body arcade pixel-art sprite of Ultraman Arc LUNA ARMOR, walking toward SCREEN RIGHT, fixed side camera. True RGBA transparent PNG; one person, one pose only.
Image 1 is the accepted character identity. Image 2 is the required full-body pose, with the WHITE leg NEAR the camera and the DARK GREY leg FAR from the camera. Use NEAR/FAR as permanent depth identities, regardless of which foot leads.
CRITICAL POSE: FAR-LEG FORWARD CONTACT. The BRIGHT SILVER NEAR thigh must slope DOWN-LEFT from its hip, connect continuously to the LEFT/BACK knee, then to the LEFT/BACK ankle and boot. The DARK SILVER FAR thigh must slope DOWN-RIGHT from its hip, connect continuously to the RIGHT/FRONT knee, then to the RIGHT/FRONT ankle and boot. The boot at screen right belongs to the DARK FAR LEG. The boot at screen left belongs to the BRIGHT NEAR LEG. Do not make the front leg bright. Both boots contact the same ground line; torso upright and centered between them. This is the opposite leg lead from a bright-front stride.
Follow the leg stance already visible in identity image 1 and the WHITE-BACK / DARK-FRONT chains of pose image 2. Animate a modest forward-walk heel contact, natural hips and shoulders, the near armored fist slightly forward in guard and the far arm slightly back. Keep all limbs attached through their own hip and knee; no swapped limb identities.
Exactly preserve this Luna identity: low silver swept head crest with its original opening, yellow eye, red-and-silver continuous suit, blue moon shoulder/chest armor, cyan chest lamp and circular cyan wrist disks. Same full-body proportions as image 1, full head and both boots within clear margins. No toy ball joints, screw holes, plastic seams, detached limbs or extra armor. Whole person redrawn together, not cut-paste, mirroring or rotating parts.
Hard pixel clusters, limited 32-color arcade palette, dark stepped outline, upper-left light. No smooth vector rendering, photo texture, blur, gradients, background, ground shadow, letters, guide lines, skeleton, grids, other people, weapons or effects. Do not draw any Q/charge glow. Whole full-body sprite on a transparent background.
